instruction: Using only the standalone stem, independently free-generate exactly one most likely condition, exactly two priority nursing actions, and exactly two monitoring or evaluation parameters. Return the required structured JSON and identify the stem evidence and any missing information needed for specificity or uniqueness.
stem: At hour 18, a 45-year-old woman admitted with acute gallstone pancreatitis has T 38.4 C, HR 118, BP 108/62, RR 26, SpO2 94% on 2 L nasal cannula, urine output 30 mL/hr, lactate 2.6 mmol/L, WBC 19.2 ×10³/µL, bilirubin 3.2 mg/dL from admission, and worsening abdominal distention and pain. Ultrasound shows an 11-mm common bile duct with a shadowing distal stone. Select the most likely condition, the two priority actions, and the two parameters to monitor.
